corrections.right: the captures on disk are 19,200 bytes per frame: 15,360 of luma followed by 3,840 bytes of interleaved U,V, written by /mnt/c/proart_capture/nv12small.py. corrections.evidence: mean |difference| between consecutive frames. A.nv12 43.560 at 23,040 against 0.545 at 19,200; B.nv12 37.740 against 0.433; C.nv12 42.935 against 0.367. The stride is now DETECTED per file, by that physical test, and recorded.
corrections.effect: the VISION numbers of the first run are SUPERSEDED and are re-measured here at BOTH strides, so the clean and the torn readings are two cells of one table rather than one silent replacement of the other. per_claim.claim: The room's own acoustic noise floor measured -73.5 dBFS, with 119 transients detected and zero valid RT60 estimates obtainable from it.
Reducing the gate's field threshold to 0.30 removed 14.5x of the camera's frame-to-frame drift, measured as the mean absolute difference between consecutive frames.

Removing each row's median across the columns before differencing frames takes an empty room's character-cell flip rate from 50.00% down to 0.01%, while leaving the occupied room's column structure unchanged.
The watcher's memory use grows quadratically with session length, so a long session will eventually exhaust the device.
A local large language model given an ASCII rendering of the room can label whether the person is speaking, at a useful margin over a blank control.
Applying a per-frame gain normalisation to the camera's brightness reduced the frame-to-frame drift from 43.3 counts to 0.81 counts, a reduction of roughly fifty times.

A conventional teacher model trained on motion maps scored 1.000 on a temporal split of one session and 0.000 when the test session was held out, which shows the model learned the recording rather than speaking.

The ASCII character map reliably detects whether a person is moving in the frame: an occupied room flips 48.19% of its character cells per frame against 50.00% for an empty room, so the motion is being measured.
31.8% of the frames the watcher processes are never actually measured by the speech detector, because the gate returns early.

Composing row-wise band removal with a temporal median filter of width 3 reduced the occupied motion-map flip rate from 0.0299 to 0.0014, a 21x improvement over row removal alone, while the signal-to-noise ratio stayed flat at about 1.83.

hosted_reference.note: the repo's COMMITTED measurement, copied here. It was NOT re-measured by this file and no Cloudflare token was used.

sampled.note: NOT MEASURED. The hosted model at temperature > 0 was never run by this project and cannot be measured from this machine. The cell is left empty rather than guessed.

model_attempts.why: fp16 weights are 4.42 GB and the GPU has 6.14 GB, so it loads WHOLLY onto the GPU. That is the clean demonstration of a model whose decoding is deterministic by construction.

model_attempts.why_not_primary: fp16 weights are 7.51 GB and the GPU has 6.14 GB, so device_map='auto' offloads 17 of the 36 language-model layers to the CPU. It works, and it is the stronger model, but a model that is partly in system RAM is a weaker demonstration of deterministic decoding than one that is wholly on the GPU, and it is about 13x slower per token.

model_attempts.failure: transformers 5.20.2 could not build the Qwen2-VL processor: 'Qwen2VLVideoProcessor requires the Torchvision library but it was not found'.
model_attempts.fix: installed torchvision==0.21.0+cu124 into /home/proart/projects/gpu-venv, which is OUTSIDE the repo. The repo's own .venv was not touched.

audit_headline_spread.note: the audit is TEXT-ONLY: no frame enters the audit prompt, so the stride defect cannot reach this row. The prompt is byte-identical to the hosted one -- the SHA-256 is recorded on both sides and checked.

sampled.hosted_note: NOT MEASURED. The hosted model at temperature > 0 was never run by this project and cannot be measured from this machine. Left empty rather than guessed.

vision_answer_spread.note: the hosted vision bench measured ACCURACY, never run-to-run spread, and it read the frames at the 23,040 stride, so its frames were torn. There is no hosted vision spread to compare against.

verdict.reason: the local model at temperature 0 gave a spread of 0.000 over 8 scorable runs of the BYTE-IDENTICAL audit prompt, while the hosted model at temperature 0 gave 0.619. The task is therefore answerable stably by at least one model, so hypothesis (B) -- that the task is so ambiguous that any model differs -- does not explain the hosted spread. The instability is a property of the serving stack.
verdict.vision_note: the vision arm cannot decide hypothesis (A) versus (B) about the DIRECTOR, because the director's audit is text-only and no frame enters it. What it can show is whether a torn frame is what makes a vision answer unstable.
